class Scheduler:''')

# 2. __init__ state
old = """        self.live = None
        self.pifo = [None] * M
        self.fifo = [[] for _ in range(M)]
        self.fhead = [0] * M
        self.fcnt = [0] * M
        self.fbytes = [0] * M
        self.pbytes = [0] * M
        self.fstamp = [0] * M
        self.registry = {}
        self.snaps = {}"""
new = """        self.live = None
        self.pifo = [None] * M
        # Staging FIFOs are lists of fixed-size chunks [stamp, items]; a chunk
        # is copied before its first mutation in a new version, so a checkpoint
        # never copies the backlog and an append never moves the queue.
        self.fchunks = [[] for _ in range(M)]
        self.fstamp = [0] * M
        self.fhc = [0] * M
        self.fho = [0] * M
        self.fslot = [0] * M
        self.fcnt = [0] * M
        self.fbytes = [0] * M
        self.pbytes = [0] * M
        self.registry = {}
        self.snaps = {}"""
assert old in src; src = src.replace(old, new)

# 3. replace _touch_fifo with the chunked FIFO primitives
old = """    def _touch_fifo(self, q):
        if self.fstamp[q] != self.ver:
            self.fifo[q] = self.fifo[q][:]
            self.fstamp[q] = self.ver
"""
new = '''    def _touch_stage(self, q):
        """Copy-on-write the chunk list of one staging FIFO."""
        if self.fstamp[q] != self.ver:
            self.fchunks[q] = self.fchunks[q][:]
            self.fstamp[q] = self.ver

    def _stage_append(self, q, pkt):
        """Queue a packet at the rear; returns its immutable staging slot."""
        self._touch_stage(q)
        chunks = self.fchunks[q]
        slot = self.fslot[q]
        if not chunks or len(chunks[-1][1]) >= STAGE_CHUNK:
            chunks.append([self.ver, [pkt]])
        else:
            chunk = chunks[-1]
            if chunk[0] != self.ver:
                chunk = [self.ver, chunk[1][:]]
                chunks[-1] = chunk
            chunk[1].append(pkt)
        self.fslot[q] = slot + 1
        return slot

    def _stage_cancel(self, q, slot):
        self._touch_stage(q)
        index = slot // STAGE_CHUNK
        chunk = self.fchunks[q][index]
        if chunk[0] != self.ver:
            chunk = [self.ver, chunk[1][:]]
            self.fchunks[q][index] = chunk
        chunk[1][slot % STAGE_CHUNK] = None

    def _stage_scan(self, q):
        """Yield the still-staged packets in arrival order (cheap iterator)."""
        chunks = self.fchunks[q]
        index = self.fhc[q]
        offset = self.fho[q]
        while index < len(chunks):
            items = chunks[index][1]
            while offset < len(items):
                pkt = items[offset]
                offset += 1
                if pkt is not None:
                    yield pkt
            index += 1
            offset = 0
        self.fhc[q] = index
        self.fho[q] = offset
'''
